# Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars

> > The Wilson Center is a nonpartisan policy forum tackling global issues through research, dialogue, and scholarship on foreign policy, international relations, and regional studies.

The Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars serves as America's living memorial to President Woodrow Wilson, connecting scholars, policymakers, and thought leaders to address critical challenges in U.S. foreign policy, democracy promotion, regional security, and global development. The Center hosts distinguished fellows, publishes original research through Wilson Center Press, and convenes high-level forums featuring world leaders and experts.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Foreign Policy
- Democracy Promotion
- National Security
- Regional Studies (Africa, Middle East, Russia, Latin America)
- International Development
- Presidential Leadership
- 9/11 Commission
- Iraq Policy
- Human Rights
- Global Governance
- Cold War History
- Nation Building
- Diplomatic Relations
- World Bank Development Projects
- Cross-Cultural Research
